rationale: A fault in section s45 is the only scenario that perfectly matches the observed data. It predicts that all three FCIs (fci_n1, fci_n2, fci_n4) would see fault current, which aligns with the observed_fci_state. It also predicts that only customer node n5 would be outaged, which exactly matches the outage_complaint_nodes. All other fault section hypotheses result in at least one mismatch between predicted and observed FCI states or outage complaints.
